execution: 64 fresh UTF-8 HTTP documents in the collaborative browser with actual OffscreenCanvas 2D pixels
limitations: Nimbo rasterizes sRGB RGBA8 axis-aligned rectangles in its own Rust software bitmap backend. No browser renderer or GPU backend is invoked.

Fractional clearing differs in all 64 variants. Clearing half an opaque red pixel gives alpha 128 in Nimbo; Chromium with willReadFrequently:true gives transparent black. A separate default-context probe gives [255,0,0,159]. Backend-dependent fractional-edge behavior remains unresolved.

The supported methods cover solid-color fillRect, clearRect, source-over alpha, state save/restore/reset, resize, getImageData/createImageData and RGBA8 ImageData construction. This is not full Canvas 2D or Web IDL/WPT conformance.
HTMLCanvasElement, paths, stroke, transforms, text, image drawing/writing, wide color spaces, image encoding/transfer, WebGL/shaders, GPU behavior and media decoding remain unimplemented.
Actual compiled-Wasm workerd tests prove this surface runs inside workerd. These tests do not prove deployed Worker CPU/memory limits, graphics challenge compatibility or page screenshots.
